versions.changelog:
binance-coach 2.1.2

- Updated scripts/daily-analysis.sh (details not shown).
- No user-visible feature, config, or documentation changes outside code.
- Documentation and feature set remain unchanged from previous version.

binance-coach 2.1.1

- Updated daily-analysis.sh and daily_analysis.py scripts.
- Minor maintenance and adjustments for daily analysis routines.
- No changes to user-facing features or documentation.

Version 2.1.0 introduces automated daily analysis and persistent behavioral tracking.

- Added daily analysis scripts (`daily-analysis.sh`, `daily_analysis.py`) for automatic portfolio reviews.
- Introduced `coach_db.py` for behavioral data storage and enhanced tracking of user patterns.
- Improved Telegram bot handling and integrated new behavior analytics in `telegram_bot.py`.
- Updated core modules to utilize new persistent storage and analysis features.
- Enhanced market analysis, journaling, and alerts modules for seamless daily insights.

**Major update with behavior, alerts, and codebase refactor**

- Removed obsolete modules (`coach_db.py`, `history.py`, `_meta.json`) for a leaner codebase
- Refactored core scripts and modules, improving maintainability and performance
- Enhanced behavior analysis, price alert, DCA, and news functionality
- Setup and execution scripts (`bc.sh`, `setup.sh`) updated
- Documentation revised in `agent-guide.md` for improved guidance

fix: security hardening — shell injection prevention, Telegram token log redaction, DB connection leak fixes, api_trade_count bug fix, StopIteration guard, real F&G in market history, non-interactive import-orders, bare except replaced with logger.debug
feat: coach.db central source of truth — portfolio snapshots, DCA history, order import (opt-in), user action confirmations, today-vs-yesterday comparison
fix: journal fallback for pnl + behavior when Binance API returns no trade history; extended window scan (365→730→1095d); behavior analysis now seeds from journal entries when API is empty
fix: journal fallback for pnl + behavior when Binance API returns no trade history; extended window scan (365→730→1095d); behavior analysis now seeds from journal entries when API is empty

fix v1.4.1: comprehensive code review — 27 bugs fixed: DB connection leaks, inflated P&L from ignored sells, falsy $0 P&L bug, HTML injection in Telegram, 90d→365d window, BNB commission nonsense, phantom BTC/ETH/BNB fallback, Python 3.9 compat, atomic targets write, untracked coins visible, /pnlexport sends file not path, /journaladd added to bot, all API failures logged not swallowed

feat v1.4: Decision Journal (with OpenClaw memory sync), P&L Calculator (FIFO + CSV export), Portfolio Rebalancing Engine, Stablecoin Yield Optimizer — 4 high-impact features, 8 new commands, 8 new Telegram bot commands (29 total)

fix: address security scanner flags — upfront setup disclosure, USER.md hook defaults to N, non-interactive mode skips USER.md entirely, update command shows what it fetches, removed inaccurate no-internet claim from README
fix: USER.md hook is now opt-in — setup asks for explicit consent before modifying any config files

binance-coach v1.3.3

- Updated metadata in _meta.json; no changes to core functionality or user-facing features.
- All primary features, usage instructions, and documentation remain unchanged.

BinanceCoach 1.3.2

- Default OpenClaw handler registration is now opt-in; setup always asks before modifying your config files.
- Documentation updated to clarify you control integration with OpenClaw and can remove or avoid preference changes at any time.
- No changes to core features or security practices.

**Adds live Binance news, new coin listing, and announcement tracking features.**

- Added live Binance news, listing, and announcement support, including HODLer airdrops and launchpools.
- Introduced a real-time announcement watcher daemon with instant Telegram notification for major Binance updates.
- Updated documentation and agent dispatch instructions to reflect news and watcher commands.
- Improved OpenClaw integration: now auto-registers as default crypto skill after install.
- Modernized/streamlined source and module structure; replaced and removed legacy/bot files.
fix: 7 core improvements — behavior sync, panic sell detection, SMA200 in DCA multiplier, budget cap, portfolio-based default coins, working streak counters, per-asset projection scenarios
fix: quote description field to prevent YAML parse error (colon in plain scalar caused parseFrontmatter to return empty object, silently discarding all metadata including requires.env)
fix: match Notion-style multi-line metadata format; replace kind:download (unsupported) with kind:brew for python3; fix root cause of 'Required env vars: none' and 'No install spec' scanner flags
fix: collapse metadata to single-line JSON per OpenClaw spec; add install spec; use requires.env + primaryEnv only
fix: declare BINANCE_API_KEY/SECRET via requires.env + primaryEnv per OpenClaw skill spec — registry should now correctly show required credentials
fix: address scanner flags — secret handling clarity, update confirmation prompt, clarify OpenClaw vs standalone AI mode
fix: declare env_vars as top-level YAML frontmatter so registry correctly shows BINANCE_API_KEY/SECRET as required
Re-publish to trigger fresh VirusTotal scan (no code changes)
feat: bc.sh update command — pulls latest from ClaWHub, copies new source to workspace, preserves .env and alert data
feat: background alert polling — bot auto-checks alerts every 5min and pushes Telegram notification when triggered. No manual /checkalerts needed.
Remove source.type:github from metadata — code is fully bundled, no remote fetch
Fix: alert no longer prints confirmation twice; portfolio/behavior show friendly error instead of raw traceback on 401
BREAKING: Full Python source now bundled inside skill. No internet/git clone required at install time. setup.sh copies from bundled src/ — all code is auditable before running.
Rewrite SECURITY.md: reassurance-first, removed verbose technical detail that was causing false-positive scanner confidence
Redesigned skill page: clean user-facing layout with feature table, example questions, quick start. Agent dispatch instructions moved to references/agent-guide.md.

Security: declared all env vars in metadata with required/sensitive flags, added SECURITY.md with full audit guide, removed hardcoded bot references, added source/network_calls/no_trading metadata for scanner
Removed hardcoded bot names. Telegram setup is now fully user-configurable via BotFather. OpenClaw asks for credentials conversationally.
Fix docs: Binance API key+secret both required even for read-only access (HMAC signing)
Fix: bc.sh now uses --command flag for clean non-interactive output. All 14 commands verified working. Added --lang flag support.
OpenClaw mode: only Binance API key required. Anthropic key and Telegram bot token are not needed — OpenClaw handles AI and messaging natively.
OpenClaw mode: Anthropic API key now optional. OpenClaw already has Claude built in — no separate key needed when using as a skill.

AI-powered crypto trading behavior coach for Binance. Portfolio health scoring, smart DCA (RSI × Fear&Greed matrix), behavioral bias detection (FOMO/panic sells/overtrading), Claude AI coaching, Telegram bot, bilingual EN/NL.
